articles.title_en: Changes in Marital Sorting: Theory and Evidence from the United States
articles.title_cn: 婚姻排序的变化：来自美国的理论和证据
articles.abstract_en: Positive assortative matching refers to the tendency of individuals with similar characteristics to form partnerships. Measuring the extent to which assortative matching differs between two economies is challenging when the marginal distributions of the sorting characteristic (e.g., education) change for either or both sexes. We show how the use of different measures can generate different conclusions. We provide an axiomatic characterization for the odds ratio, normalized trace, and likelihood ratio and provide a structural economic interpretation of the odds ratio. We use our approach to show that marital sorting by education substantially changed between the 1950s and the 1970s cohorts.
articles.abstract_cn: 正选型匹配是指具有相似特征的个体倾向于形成伙伴关系。当任一性别或两性的分类特征（例如教育）的边际分布发生变化时，衡量二经济体之间选型匹配的差异程度具有挑战性。我们展示了使用不同的测量方法如何产生不同的结论。我们提供了优势比、归一化轨迹和似然比的公理化表征，并提供了优势比的结构性经济学解释。我们使用我们的方法来表明，1950 和 1970 群体之间按教育程度进行的婚姻排序发生了显着变化。

articles.title_en: Black Empowerment and White Mobilization: The Effects of the Voting Rights Act
articles.title_cn: 黑人赋权和白人动员：投票权法案的影响
articles.abstract_en: How did Southern whites respond to the 1965 Voting Rights Act (VRA)? Leveraging newly digitized data on county-level voter registration by race between 1956 and 1980 and exploiting predetermined variation in exposure to the federal intervention, we document that the VRA increases both Black and white political participation. Consistent with the VRA triggering white countermobilization, the surge in white registrations is concentrated in counties where African Americans represent a political threat. Countermobilization leads to a short-run increase in support for racially conservative candidates and to a slowdown in local public spending salient to Black Americans, such as public-sector employment and education.
articles.abstract_cn: 南方白人对1965投票权法案（VRA）有何反应？利用 1956 和 1980 之间按种族划分的县级选民登记的新数字化数据，并利用联邦干预风险的预定变化，我们记录了 VRA 增加了黑人和白人的政治参与。与 VRA 引发的白人反动员一致，白人登记激增集中在非裔美国人构成政治威胁的县。反动员导致短期内对种族保守派候选人的支持增加，并导致对美国黑人来说很重要的地方公共支出放缓，例如公共部门就业和教育。

articles.title_en: Leveraging the Disagreement on Climate Change: Theory and Evidence
articles.title_cn: 利用气候变化问题上的分歧：理论与证据
articles.abstract_en: We develop a credit search model with maturity choice where agents disagree on when a long-run disaster will damage collateral assets. It predicts that disaster-pessimistic agents are more likely to leverage risky asset purchases and prefer debt contracts with longer maturities. Intuitively, pessimists value the default option of debt contracts as implicit disaster insurance, whose coverage increases with maturity implicitly and costs less to optimistic lenders. Using high-resolution sea level rise projections and comprehensive propriety data on coastal real estate and mortgages, we find robust evidence of these predictions. The findings provide relevant policy implications on insurance mandates, securitization, disaster assistance, and financial stability.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种具有期限选择的信用搜索模型，其中代理人对于长期灾难何时会损害抵押资产存在分歧。它预测，对灾难持悲观态度的代理人更有可能利用杠杆购买高风险资产，并更喜欢期限较长的债务合同。直观上，悲观主义者将债务合同的默认选项视为隐性灾难保险，其保险范围随着到期日而隐性增加，并且乐观贷款人的成本较低。利用高分辨率海平面上升预测和沿海房地产和抵押贷款的综合产权数据，我们找到了这些预测的有力证据。研究结果提供了对保险授权、证券化、灾害援助和金融稳定的相关政策影响。

articles.abstract_en: We consider sequential search by an agent who cannot observe the quality of goods but can acquire information from a profit-maximizing principal with limited commitment power. The principal can charge higher prices for more informative signals, but high future prices discourage continued search, thereby reducing the principal’s profits. A unique stationary equilibrium outcome exists: the principal (i) sells the agent only partial information, (ii) induces the socially efficient stopping rule, and (iii) extracts the full surplus. However, introducing an additional, free source of information can lead to inefficiency in equilibrium.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑由代理人进行顺序搜索，该代理人无法观察商品的质量，但可以从承诺权力有限的利润最大化委托人那里获取信息。委托人可以对信息更丰富的信号收取更高的价格，但未来的高价格会阻碍继续搜索，从而减少委托人的利润。存在独特的平稳均衡结果：委托人（i）仅向代理人出售部分信息，（ii）引入社会有效的停止规则，以及（iii）提取全部剩余。然而，引入额外的免费信息源可能会导致均衡效率低下。

articles.title_en: Selecting Penalty Parameters of High-Dimensional M-Estimators Using Bootstrapping after Cross Validation
articles.title_cn: 在交叉验证后使用自举选择高维 M 估计器的惩罚参数
articles.abstract_en: We develop a new method for selecting the penalty parameter for ℓ1-penalized M-estimators in high dimensions, which we refer to as bootstrapping after cross validation. We derive rates of convergence for the corresponding ℓ1-penalized M-estimator and also for the post-ℓ1-penalized M-estimator, which refits the nonzero entries of the former estimator without penalty in the criterion function. We demonstrate via simulations that our methods are not dominated by cross validation in terms of estimation errors and can outperform cross validation in terms of inference. As an empirical illustration, we revisit Fryer (2019), who investigated racial differences in police use of force, and confirm his findings.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种新方法，用于选择高维 ℓ1 惩罚 M 估计量的惩罚参数，我们将其称为交叉验证后的引导。我们推导了相应的 ℓ1 惩罚 M 估计器以及后 ℓ1 惩罚 M 估计器的收敛率，它重新拟合了前一个估计器的非零条目，而在准则函数中没有惩罚。我们通过模拟证明，我们的方法在估计误差方面不受交叉验证的支配，并且在推理方面可以优于交叉验证。作为实证说明，我们重新审视弗莱尔（2019），他调查了警察使用武力的种族差异，并证实了他的发现。

articles.title_en: Religious Divisions and Production Technology: Experimental Evidence from India
articles.title_cn: 宗教划分与生产技术：来自印度的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper implements a field experiment in India to study whether the effects of religious diversity on productivity and attitudes depend on a firm’s production technology. I randomly assigned Hindu and Muslim workers at a manufacturing plant in West Bengal to mixed or homogeneous teams. Production tasks are categorized as high or low dependency based on the degree of continuous coordination required. Mixed teams are less productive than homogeneous teams in high-dependency tasks, but this effect attenuates completely in 4 months. In low-dependency tasks, diversity does not affect productivity. However, mixing improves Hindu workers’ out-group attitudes only in high-dependency tasks.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文在印度进行了一项实地实验，研究宗教多样性对生产力和态度的影响是否取决于企业的生产技术。我将西孟加拉邦一家制造工厂的印度教和穆斯林工人随机分配到混合或同质的团队中。根据所需的持续协调程度，生产任务分为高依赖性或低依赖性。在高度依赖的任务中，混合团队的生产力低于同质团队，但这种影响会在 4 个月内完全减弱。在低依赖性任务中，多样性不会影响生产力。然而，只有在高度依赖的任务中，混合才能改善印度教工人的外群体态度。

articles.title_en: Persuasion and Information Aggregation in Elections
articles.title_cn: 选举中的说服和信息聚合
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies a large majority election with voters who have heterogeneous private preferences and exogenous private information about an unknown state of the world. We show that a Bayesian persuader can achieve any state-contingent outcome in some equilibrium by providing additional information. In this setting, without the persuader’s additional information, a version of the Condorcet jury theorem holds, in the sense that outcomes of large elections satisfy full-information equivalence. Persuasion does not require detailed knowledge of the voters’ private information, preferences, or the voting rule. It also requires almost no commitment power on the part of the persuader.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了大多数选民的选举，这些选民具有不同的私人偏好和关于未知世界状况的外生私人信息。我们表明，贝叶斯说服者可以通过提供附加信息在某种均衡中实现任何状态相关的结果。在这种情况下，在没有说服者额外信息的情况下，孔多塞陪审团定理的一个版本成立，即大型选举的结果满足全信息等价。说服不需要详细了解选民的私人信息、偏好或投票规则。它还几乎不需要说服者的承诺力。

articles.title_en: Rationed Fertility: Treatment Effect Heterogeneity in the Child Quantity-Quality Trade-Off
articles.title_cn: 定量生育：儿童数量与质量权衡中的治疗效果异质性
articles.abstract_en: We develop a generalized theory of rationed fertility to analyze treatment effect heterogeneity in the child quantity-quality trade-off. An exogenous increase in fertility can be either desired or undesired. We derive a positive rationing income effect on child quality for desired fertility increases but a negative rationing income effect for undesired fertility increases. We propose an econometric framework to identify treatment effects of desired and undesired fertility increases and estimate a structural model to gauge the quantitative importance of the novel rationing income effect. Our study highlights the importance of distinguishing between desired and undesired changes when evaluating social programs.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们发展了一种广义的定量生育理论来分析儿童数量与质量权衡中的治疗效果异质性。生育力的外源性增加可以是期望的，也可以是不期望的。我们得出，对于期望的生育率增加，配给收入对儿童质量有正向的影响，但对于不期望的生育率的增加，配给收入则有负的影响。我们提出了一个计量经济学框架来识别期望和不期望的生育率增加的治疗效果，并估计一个结构模型来衡量新型配给收入效应的数量重要性。我们的研究强调了在评估社会项目时区分期望和不期望的变化的重要性。
